methodology.description: Public draft-helper PPR redraft board. Player value and market cost are intentionally kept separate. Rankings blend broad expert consensus, current projections, recent independent expert boards and material preseason/news context; ADP is treated as price rather than player quality. League scoring, roster construction, draft slot, drafted players, positional scarcity and next-pick pressure are applied by the client recommendation engine.
rankingInputs: FantasyPros 2026 PPR expert consensus and individual boards updated Aug. 24-25, including Andrew Erickson and Derek Brown
ESPN 2026 draft guide, Field Yates and Mike Clay preseason rankings updated through Aug. 25
CBS Sports consensus Top 200 and SportsLine breakout/bust model updates from Aug. 24
RotoWire multi-analyst PPR board and ADP cross-check
NFL.com, ESPN, Reuters and team-source late-August injury/depth-chart reporting
FantasyPros consensus projections and current aggregated ADP
methodology.marketInput: Current FantasyPros aggregated ADP remains the primary market-price input, cross-checked against CBS and RotoWire ADP. ADP is a price signal, not a substitute for player value. Several first-round market prices tightened on Aug. 25, especially Puka Nacua and Jaxon Smith-Njigba.
newsInputs: Malik Nabers practiced Aug. 24 without the red non-contact jersey for the first time in camp, worked in team drills, and John Harbaugh said it is reasonable to assume he is trending toward Week 1 availability barring a setback. This is a genuine recovery milestone, though SportsLine's Aug. 24 model remains materially lower on his season-long value than several human rankers.

Ashton Jeanty remained out of practice Aug. 24 after the right ankle sprain. The injury is still not considered long-term, but no return timetable has been established; Mike Washington Jr. continues to take the contingency workload.

Omarion Hampton received additional independent support from SportsLine's Aug. 24 breakout model, which emphasized his prior bell-cow usage and improved offensive-line context. This supports the existing aggressive rank but does not justify another major move by itself.
Christian McCaffrey's Aug. 23 return to practice remains the latest meaningful health signal; no setback was found in this refresh.
No new suspension, trade or depth-chart change involving another top-30 player was found that justified a large value move in this refresh.
methodology.notes: Expert disagreement is preserved with expertLow/expertHigh ranges; unresolved injuries and genuine model disagreement can intentionally widen those ranges. Confidence reflects agreement plus news certainty, not ceiling. The Aug. 25 refresh modestly upgrades Malik Nabers after a concrete contact-progress milestone, while widening his downside range because a current independent model remains skeptical. Ashton Jeanty stays heavily discounted until Las Vegas provides a return timetable. Market/ADP changes are updated separately from player value. This file is used only by smhillis/sleeper-draft-helper-public and must not be copied into or used to modify Scott's personal Sleeper Draft Assistant.

players.name: James Cook III
players.news: Strong current expert support remains in place; market is now pricing him firmly near the first/second-round turn.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.news: Returned to practice Aug. 23 after nearly three weeks sidelined by generalized tightness. Week 1 remains the target; injury risk is reduced, not erased.

players.name: Chris Olave
players.news: Jordyn Tyson's hamstring issue improves Olave's already strong target-volume outlook.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.news: NFL closed its investigation with no additional discipline. Knee recovery remains the main risk, materially reducing the prior suspension discount.

players.name: Omarion Hampton
players.news: SportsLine's Aug. 24 breakout model adds independent support to the existing bull case: prior bell-cow usage plus a healthier, upgraded offensive line. Market price remains materially higher than his public-board value rank.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.news: Shed the red non-contact jersey Aug. 24, worked in team drills and is now trending toward Week 1 availability barring a setback. Human rankers are moving more optimistic, while SportsLine's current model remains notably bearish, so the downside range stays wide.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.news: Sprained right ankle Aug. 23 and remained out of practice Aug. 24. The injury is not expected to be long-term, but there is still no timetable. Market ADP has not caught up, leaving the largest value/price gap on the board until Las Vegas gives a clearer return date.
